notes.title: Kickstarter Launched
notes.content:
We have launched a campaign on Kickstarter for 30 days.

We need to raise $6000 to implement all the features of our game.
You can support the project and already purchase it for your Steam library at the following link: http://kck.st/3WbKunW


Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012976/b9be90e99b151b0b8679af0055b3a24a9cd2377f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Kickstarter launch soon
notes.content:
Hello,
Soon we will launch a Kickstarter campaign to raise some funds to be able to create our game Echo of Prypiat the best we can.

You will be able to buy our game and add to your Steam Library by making a donation on our Kickstarter page. This will help us create the best possible game we can for you to experience and explore.
Also by making a small donation of $1 you will get some additional photo cards of our game, screenshots, logo in high quality, and you can also ask any question to us - developers :)

Visit our page here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/echoofpripyat/echo-of-pripyat-pc-walking-simulator-game-in-chornobyl?ref=clipboard-prelaunch


Thank you,
For your support and faith in us.
